newsitem.title: SWEDEN: AssiDoman raises kraftliner price April 1. [CORRECTED 17:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: AssiDoman raises kraftliner price April 1. [CORRECTED 17:25 GMT]

text.p: Swedish forestry company AssiDoman AB said on Wednesday it was increasing its prices on kraftliner by 10 percent or 80 marks from April 1. (Corrects from "10 percent to 80 marks")

"We see very good demand for kraftliner and believe it will hold. The strong dollar has also played a role in our decision to raise prices," said Ulf Kilander, managing director for Assidoman Packaging, in a statement.
